defect_location.description: CVE-2015-3148: Negotiate 认证连接被错误复用（CVE 描述: do not properly re-use authenticated Negotiate connections, which allows remote attackers to connect as other users via a request）。逻辑缺陷 → 诚实标 miss。

source.simplification: 剥离 Negotiate 认证流程，保留『连接复用不检查认证身份一致性』核心缺陷

trigger_condition: user1 完成 Negotiate 认证后，user2 的请求错误复用该已认证连接
